title: Building a Ready, Resilient and Relevant Workforce in the Financial Sector
what_it_is: Building a Ready, Resilient and Relevant Workforce in the Financial Sector

sections.label: Bank layoffs announced
sections.summary: Standard Chartered, HSBC and Credit Suisse announced global job cuts of 15,000, 50,000 and 4,000 workers respectively.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: Standard Chartered announced in November last year that it plans to lay off 15,000 workers from its 86,000-strong global workforce by 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: HSBC had also announced it would slash 50,000 jobs worldwide through 2017 as part of a global overhaul.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: Credit Suisse also announced 4,000 job cuts globally after the Swiss bank reported its first annual loss since the Global Financial Crisis just weeks ago.

sections.label: Local banks still hiring
sections.summary: Jobs are being created in compliance, risk management and IT, and the three local banks remain profitable and are still hiring.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: Notwithstanding, jobs were being created in the financial industry, especially in growth areas within the sector, such as in the areas of compliance, risk management and information technology (IT).

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: It is heartening to note from the recent financial results of our three local banks – United Overseas Bank, DBS and Overseas-Chinese Banking Corporation – that they are profitable in 2015 and are still healthy, stable and are reportedly still hiring and not expected to undertake drastic headcount cuts.

sections.label: Layoffs hit PMEs hardest
sections.summary: Recent banking layoffs affect PMEs hardest, with many laid off being mature, above-40 experienced staff including well-performing frontline bankers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: The recent rise in layoffs in the banking sector affects PMEs the hardest.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: Anecdotally, many of those laid off are the mature, above 40 age group, experienced staff, including some well-performing frontline bankers who met their key performance indicators, yet had to be let go to cut costs.

sections.label: Fair retrenchment guidelines
sections.summary: Employers needing to lay off workers are called to do so fairly and responsibly, following TAFEP and tripartite guidelines.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: Even if employers need to lay off workers, I call out to them to do it fairly and responsibly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: We have the Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices (TAFEP) guidelines on Managing Excess Manpower and the Tripartite Code of Good Industrial Relations Practice which are instructive documents and guidelines on how and what to do before a retrenchment is carried out.

sections.label: Financial Sector Tripartite Committee launched
sections.summary: The Financial Sector Tripartite Committee was formed and launched to build a financial workforce meeting changing industry needs, with IBF collaboration and a career advisory centre.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: All said, I am glad to share that, reflecting the spirit of tripartism and as a key SkillsFuture initiative for the financial sector, we have formed last year and recently officially launched the Financial Sector Tripartite Committee (FSTC) which brings together the industry associations, employers, financial cluster unions/Labour Movement and the Government to work in unison to build a common future by fostering a financial workforce that can meet the changing needs of the industry.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: As part of the broader SkillsFuture agenda, it is important to equip financial sector professionals with information and knowledge to continuously upgrade themselves and better align their training efforts with their career development.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: We will be embarking on the collaboration with the Institute of Banking and Finance (IBF) to continually review the IBF Standards and identify new cross-functional competencies needed, such as in data analytics and risk management.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: Structured progression pathways will also be developed for evolving job segments, including consumer banking, to encourage continuous learning and upskilling.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: FSTC will also set up a financial sector-specific one-stop career advisory facility in April this year, leveraging the U PME Centre's operational experiences and infrastructure at NTUC Centre in One Marina Boulevard.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: This Financial Industry Career Advisory Centre (FiCAC) will provide guidance to those keen to join the financial industry as well as those looking to move to new jobs within the industry.

sections.label: FSTC addresses worker anxiety
sections.summary: FSTC, co-chaired by Mr Patrick Tay, was set up to bring together industry associations, the Labour Movement and Government agencies amid worker anxiety.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In the interim, we understand that the changes taking place are a cause for anxiety among affected financial sector workers, especially the mid-career professionals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This is one reason why we have set up FSTC with Mr Patrick Tay as Co-Chairman, to bring together industry associations, the Labour Movement and Government agencies to foster a workforce that can meet the changing needs of the financial industry.

sections.label: FiCAC advisory facility setup
sections.summary: An advisory facility, FiCAC, will be set up in April focusing first on banking, then insurance and asset management.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We are setting up processes and mechanisms to help those, especially the mid-career professionals, who are affected.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This advisory facility, FiCAC, will be set up in April this year, starting with a focus on the banking sector and it will be extended to insurance and asset management sectors in the near future.

sections.label: Retail Banking Earn and Learn
sections.summary: The first Retail Banking Earn and Learn Programme for polytechnic students will be implemented next year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In particular, our polytechnic students can look forward to the first Retail Banking Earn and Learn Programme, which will be implemented next year.

sections.label: Finance training support schemes
sections.summary: The Finance Scholarship Programme and Financial Sector SkillsFuture Study Award provide financial support for Singaporeans to develop skills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: For example, we have the Finance Scholarship Programme (FSP) to support early- and mid-career Singaporeans in developing specialist capabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We also recently launched Financial Sector SkillsFuture Study Award which is another channel of financial support to enable individuals to upgrade their skills through a range of programmes.

sections.label: Training pathways and competencies
sections.summary: Key evolving jobs will be identified and structured training pathways developed, including new competencies like data analytics and digital banking.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We will need to pre-emptively identify the key jobs that are evolving and develop structured training pathways for professionals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We must identify new cross-functional competencies that may be needed for finance professionals, new competencies like data analytics and digital banking; new competencies that will help our professionals to be more resilient in the future.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Third, we will continue to work closely with the key financial institutions to build a strong core of Singaporean finance professionals and uphold fair employment practices.

sections.label: Singaporean talent in finance
sections.summary: Financial institutions are taking steps to strengthen their Singaporean talent base and ensure more Singaporeans hold leadership positions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Many of them are taking proactive steps to strengthen their Singaporean talent base.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We want to ensure that there are more Singaporeans taking up leadership positions in our key financial institutions.
